video_title: Why Steph Curry the CLEAR choice over Kevin Durant to start a franchise👀

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry's legacy is superior to Kevin Durant's due to team success
quotes.excerpt: His legacy will never be with Stephen Curry's is, because of what Stephen Curry's done and his team success.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I think Kevin Durant's legacy will never be what Stephen Curry's is, because of what Stephen Curry's done and his team success.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Are you talking about overall legacy, or are you saying like his legacy will never be with Stephen Curry's is, because of what Stephen Curry's done and his team success.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant would have continued winning Finals MVPs without leaving Golden State
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Durant would have continued to get those Finals MVPs. He got everyone.
quotes.quote: If Kevin Durant, let's say he never left Golden State, he would have continued to get those Finals MVPs. He got everyone.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry is the most efficient player to ever play basketball
quotes.excerpt: He's the most efficient player ever played the game of basketball.
quotes.quote: He's the most efficient player ever played the game of basketball. There's not a soul that could argue that.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's lack of a point guard has hindered his championship success
quotes.excerpt: I think that is the one thing Kevin Durant has missed for years.
quotes.quote: If I get me a good point guard, I think that is the one thing Kevin Durant has missed for years. If he's had a point guard and a good team around him, Kevin Durant is a motherfucker.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry and Kevin Durant are very close in overall player ranking
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Durant and Stephen Curry are very close.
quotes.quote: Kevin Durant and Stephen Curry are very close. Kevin Durant is up there with being the best. He's one of the best players.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Starting a franchise with either Stephen Curry or Kevin Durant is correct
quotes.excerpt: I would not go wrong starting a franchise with either one of those guys.
quotes.quote: I would not go wrong starting a franchise with either one of those guys. Kevin Durant is one of the best players to ever play this game.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry is the preferred choice for starting a new franchise
quotes.excerpt: If I'm starting my franchise, with what I know about Stephen Curry, I got to roll.
quotes.quote: If I'm starting my franchise, with what I know about Stephen Curry, I got to roll.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: This season is Kevin Durant's best chance to win a championship
quotes.excerpt: I think this is Kevin Durant's best chance he's had in years.
quotes.quote: I think this is Kevin Durant's best chance he's had in years. This is Kevin Durant's best chance since Kyrie, James Harden, and him to win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: A healthy Nets core of Durant, Harden, and Irving would have won
quotes.excerpt: If James Harden and Kyrie Irving and Kevin Durant don't get hurt, they're winning that bitch.
quotes.quote: If James Harden and Kyrie Irving and Kevin Durant don't get hurt, they're winning that bitch.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry changed the game of basketball more than any other player
quotes.excerpt: Steph didn't change the game more than anybody though.
quotes.quote: Steph didn't change the game more than anybody though. He changed the entire game, maybe more than anybody.
